messages:
dmitri: :rotating_light: nightly-perf-ci p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~340ms on small-batch run (00:03 UTC). Opening thread to coordinate profiling/capture. artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/nightly/3865009999/ops.zip

sam: oncall ack. do you have the failing commit hash or job id?

dmitri: job #9274. bisect points to commit range 4f7c2b0..4f7c2b3, suspect introduced in 4f7c2b3. trying local repro but need kernel-level traces.

carmen: @dmitri can you paste the bench config used so we run exact same workload?

dmitri: config snippet:
```yaml
batch_size: 8
seq_len: 1024
model: rwd-open-7b
quant: q4_0
warmer_iters: 10
capture_metrics: [p95, p99, tail]
```

jamie: :eyes: i'll take perf recording tonight. can we reserve a 15m window on staging-g4pool? prefer 00:30-00:50 UTC.

dmitri: assigned to @jamie. i've pinned model snapshot and set `CI_SAMPLE_TAG=regress-3865` on the job.

ops-bot: Reservation created: staging-g4pool slot 00:30-00:50 UTC. Job template: `bench/run-nightly --tag regress-3865`

jamie: plan: run `perf record -F 99 -g -- bench/run.sh --sample-mode kernel` then `perf report` + flamegraphs. will also collect `dmesg` and NV capture (`nvprof`/`nvidia-smi dmon`). uploading to s3.

priya: quick Q — last similar spike was allocator-related (mmap churn). can someone grep flamegraph for `mmap|malloc|copy_user` after upload?

dmitri: good call. artifacts include `traces/stackcollapse-*.txt`. i'll search for `mmap|malloc|kv_cache`.

sam: if allocator suspected, let's also try a jemalloc tweak locally. @jamie can you run an extra job with `MALLOC_CONF=lg_chunk:1` and tag `regress-3865-jemalloc`?

jamie: will run baseline + jemalloc tweak during the window, label outputs. ETA ~25m after window ends.

carmen: if traces point to code, i'll start a bisect on the 4f7c2b0..4f7c2b3 range tomorrow morning and call out suspects in PR.

dmitri: for local repro use: `export REDWOOD_SAMPLE_SIZE=1000 && pytest -k nightly_perf --capture=no` to get deterministic sample traces. also added `--repro-seed=3865` to the CI job.

sam: :thumbsup: ping @eng-runtime if you need help interpreting perf output. i'll triage fallout if we need a rollback.

jamie: uploaded results: s3://redwood-ci/nightly/3865009999/perf/ — includes `perf.data`, `report.txt`, flamegraphs. quick note: kernel stacks show heavy time in `copy_user_generic_unrolled` and a spike in `mmap` syscalls during startup.

priya: :thinking_face: digging into flamegraph now. `copy_user` pattern suggests extra memcpy or unexpected host<->device copies — could be batching change that forces extra materialize.

dmitri: adding to runbook: if kernel copy/mmap is culprit, try re-running with `--use-shared-inputs` and reduced prefetch to confirm. if that mitigates, prepare a config toggle PR + canary rollout.

sam: next steps: (1) confirm with jemalloc and shared-inputs runs, (2) if mitigated, open PR with toggle + unit test, (3) canary to 10% traffic and monitor p95. thanks all for the quick turnaround.
